caption: The drawing depicts a small house with a prominent red roof and three tall red chimneys, each topped with gold-colored decorative crown-like elements. The main body of the house is mainly white with areas of gray, resembling patches or faded paint. The roof has a gable at the front, decorated with gold leafy ornaments, and above its apex is a triangular section with a pattern of diagonal shapes in black and white. The front of the house has a porch with a red roof, supported by two slender white posts, and bordered by a gold fringe-like detail. Below the porch roof, there is a large, white, rectangular window with an intricate crisscross lattice pattern. The house sits on a broad, flat red base. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Bank: Toy Building
